statusHistory.note: Operator request (chat, 2026-09-21): third Salvador pin, a hidden-gem hotel pick. Solar das Artes Pousada Boutique is a small (8-9 room), independently run boutique inn in a colonial mansion in Pelourinho, doubling as an art gallery/cultural space per Salvador's own city tourism portal (Pelourinho Dia e Noite). Deliberately picked over the area's bigger-name hotels (Villa Bahia, Fasano-tier options) as a genuinely smaller, less-marketed pick consistent with operator direction to avoid mainstream-hype venues. Google Maps verified live via browser: 4.4 stars, 158 reviews, 3-star hotel classification, R. das Laranjeiras 34, Centro Histórico/Pelourinho. Reviews (aggregated via Google's TripAdvisor cross-listing) consistently name a host, Cris, as warmly helpful; rooms described as spacious with good air conditioning, some top-floor rooms with a large private terrace; the surrounding street flagged as safe and well-lit. Official website (solardasartessalvador.com.br) is currently unreachable (DNS failure) — noted rather than silently worked around; no official Instagram account was confirmed in this pass, so a Google Maps listing photo was used for the hero image instead, per operator direction that hero images must be real (non-AI-generated) photos or venue-sourced art. No genuine dated event applicable to a lodging pin. Single coordinator, no subagents, per the operator's standing token-efficiency directive.
